statements.status_notes: CloudNativePG 1.27 is past end-of-life upstream; the fix for CVE-2026-44477 was backported only to the v1.28.x (>=1.28.3) and v1.29.x (>=1.29.1) release lines. No backport to 1.27 is planned. Assessment of whether the 1.27 image should be retired or carry a forward-port of the cnpg_metrics_exporter role patch is pending.
